sourceTitle: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
sourceText:
Peanut Butter Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:57am

Ingredients




1/2 cup Butter
2 tablespoons Butter
1/2 cup Peanut butter
2 tablespoons Peanut butter
3/4 cup Firmly packed brown sugar
1/2 cup Granulated sugar
1 Egg
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 1/2 cups All-purpose flour
1 teaspoon Baking soda
1 teaspoon Salt, optional
3 cups Old-fashioned oats, uncooked
1 ounce pkt Semisweet chocolate chips, 12

Preparation

1 1. Heat oven to 375'F. Beat butters and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Add combined flour, baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in 2 Oats and chocolate chips. 3 2. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8-9 4 Minutes for a chewy cookie, 10-11 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 1 5 Minute on cookie sheet, remove to wire rack, cool, store tightly 6 Covered. 7 Makes 4-1/2 dozen cookies.
